jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Chad has no AI-specific law or published AI strategy. Its framework rests on the 2015 personal data protection law, whose official text could not be read. A Directorate-General for AI was reportedly created in October 2025 and a national digital transformation and AI strategy for 2026-2031 is being prepared with UNDP support, but neither has a published official text. Most government websites, including the official gazette portal and the digital ministry, could not be accessed during this review.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Economy
Presidency of the Republic of Chad
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but the official gazette, the presidency, the digital ministry and the national ICT agency websites could not be accessed, so no document could be read in full. Chad is marked for a later retry.

instruments.current_status: Listed as a law in force on the official page of the electronic communications regulator (ARCEP), alongside Law 006/PR/2015 creating ANSICE (the national IT security and electronic certification agency) and Law 009/PR/2015 on cybersecurity. The linked official PDF was broken on 2026-10-12, so the text could not be read; promulgation date (reported elsewhere as 10 February 2015) and its implementing decree (reported as Decree 075/PR/2019) are unverified from official sources. Chad has no AI-specific law.
instruments.summary: Chad's general personal data protection law, part of the 2015 package of digital laws (with laws on ANSICE, electronic transactions and cybersecurity) listed by the national electronic communications regulator. It sets the legal framework for processing personal data in Chad and so governs data used to train and run AI systems; its specific obligations could not be checked because the official text was not accessible.
